Let's calculate the density in g/cm³:

1. Convert the volume from Å³ to cm³:
   \[
   6374.4951 \, \text{Å}^3 = 6374.4951 \times 10^{-24} \, \text{cm}^3
   \]

2. Calculate the mass of 500 copper atoms:
   \[
   \text{mass} = \frac{500 \times 63.546 \, \text{g/mol}}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \, \text{atoms/mol}} = 5.273 \times 10^{-22} \, \text{g}
   \]

3. Calculate the density:
   \[
   \text{density} = \frac{5.273 \times 10^{-22} \, \text{g}}{6374.4951 \times 10^{-24} \, \text{cm}^3} = 8.27 \, \text{g/cm}^3
   \]

The density is approximately 8.27 g/cm³.
